title: FUTURE-AI: Guiding Principles and Consensus Recommendations for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in Medical Imaging
reasoning: The paper focuses on establishing and providing an evaluation framework (the FUTURE-AI Quality Check) for technical, clinical, and ethical trustworthiness in medical imaging AI. It explicitly details a 55-item checklist used to evaluate components such as Fairness and Explainability as part of an ethical AI implementation.
